So Weeaboo goes full retard and is a Kitsune level 5 Naruto Ninja of Idiocy (furry shit was happening and let's leave that alone okay), Hambeast is Halfling Cleric since Halfling Chick CHA 19= hot irl or some shit, Conspirtard pretends his fat short ass is a dwarf fighter (not to big a stretch to be honest) and Skolnick is SUPRISE! an Elf Wizard... wtf man this shit was playing out like a greentext in my head as I was sitting there. So what about me? What makes me so special huh!? Nothing, I watch my diet and exercise enough to not get fat along with working as a federal employee. Nothing special just an asshole really who is doing okay in life. Well either way I opt for Half-Elf Archaeologist Bard, a bit munchkin but fills a needed role of actual face not trying to seduce everything and everyone at the table...ugh... while being useful to pick up the slack in the rogue area since NINJAS KICK IN DOORS THROUGH THE WINDOW ( Promise to get to that later, really I do).

Anyways so after realizing that the Wizard has never actually played a caster and no one is willing to help him I decided to help him out. Built him a fully working spellbook for his laptop in about an hour or so, only level 5 so not super involved here or anything. Tracks what he knows, what he has for the day, what is used and a description for each along with relevant mechanics. So after the initial character selection where everyone was cunfuckled as to what exactly I was playing as, seriously guys it's a goddamn trope almost, we met back up next week.

Setting: N^N+3 shadowy cornered pub where N= number of occupants. Large overdressed human enters, filthy peasant is human so everyone in party turns up nose at lowely human, surrounded by EPIC BODYGAURDS OF DEATH who manage to view the universe in some weird fractal way that allows them to see and hear inside corners in rooms not facing them. Big speech happens where Obvious Rich Human ends with Obvious Evil Yet Almost Innocent Sounding Remark and offer of SHINY STUFF. Well humans are crap but titles and gold are always good even if comes from slimy human scum. Still though I push on and try to get some high rp going on, or any real rp for that matter to be honest. Well that ends akwardly and we fast forward to straight up hack and slash in record time. Big Rich needs us to escort someone for him around town since his level FUCK YOU bodyguards are still somehow magically inferior to us. I roll some excellent rolls and determine it is all bullshit along with a high chance of this being a set up where we all will die. So group decides that instead of working the role of what Jackwagon the Bumbling Fool aka our primary is worth killing for they decide to go after Big Rich. He will pay or some shit like that, for his evilness... or whatever, honestly I think they just wanted to kill a bunch of people and rob the rich guy. Not my problem though, I took the primary, so much easier without their 'help', and began a side mission of the uhh main storyline...

Don't worry it gets better by this time irl the DM needed a smoke break so I took that time to write out what I wanted to do and left blank the spots for the roll results. Fairly simple stuff, use Perception, Stealth, K. Local and diplomacy to get to an opium den and find somewhere to hide out for a bit while I get Bumbling Fool calmed down and a bit high to I can interrogate him nice like. Rolls are good and okay so works out fine it seems. Rest of party no shock here, gets their ass handed to them on a silver platter faster than I could say told you so. The DM gloats over them and fucks with them before realizing the entire party sans me is about to die. With some serious fudgery on the DMs part they somehow get out just on this side of dead. Which is great because despite me doing my own thing, despite me being sneaky like a snake in the grass they then crash in as I am interrogating the guy and take offense to be drugging him to calm him down. Like wtf?? Okay whatever is what it is I will keep on rolling with it since there is actually some humor at the table and it is okay despite Skolnick the Wizards laugh in my ear every two minutes because if I don't sit by him he has no idea what to do with his Wizard... So after getting almost murdered out of sheer idiocy they didn't once think to make sure they had no one following them as they Basset Hound straight to me, Which we discovered rather fast as an enemy jumped out and took our primary hostage. Follow them or primary dies it seems was the choice. I understood it I really did, so did Weeaboo, or he just wanted to be all "No I will save you!" not sure which and don't really care to be honest. What matters is that Dwarfy DOES NOT NEGOTIATE WITH TERRORIST! I was beginning to think he was mildly retarded before this and now I was sure.

With a vicious gleam in his eye and a rustle of his beard Dwarfy pulls forth his trusty handaxe. A handaxe that has seen more blood than all the battlefields in all the world combined. A trusty handaxe that has the weight of a million Dwarven souls screaming as it streaks towards the enemy. It is the power and majesty of the Dwarven people made incarnate. It was on sale for only 4gp so at that rate who can afford to say no? As he reached across the room in a blur of majestic beard and righteous axe he argues with the DM and wins the Rite Of Coup de Grâce against our primary since he is high out of his mind right now. Our primary dies and with him so does the transcontinental railroad that had been planned. But never fear! Endless waves of random enemies are here to hasten our escape into the cleverly created trap that will once again lay forth the steel lines of a truly great railroad!
